noaa-solar-calc.title: Solar calculation details (NOAA Solar Calculator)
noaa-solar-calc.note: Documents the equations behind NOAA's solar position and sunrise/sunset calculators, taken from Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, with downloadable spreadsheets. physics/solar.js follows these equations.

reda-andreas-2004.title: Solar position algorithm for solar radiation applications
reda-andreas-2004.note: NREL's Solar Position Algorithm (SPA). pvlib's implementation of it is the reference our solar-position code is tested against.

liu-jordan-1963.authors: Liu, B. Y. H.; Jordan, R. C.
liu-jordan-1963.title: The long-term average performance of flat-plate solar-energy collectors: with design data for the U.S., its outlying possessions and Canada
liu-jordan-1963.note: The classic source of the tilted-surface method that treats sky light as isotropic (the isotropic sky model).

kamphuis-2020.authors: Kamphuis, N. R.; Gueymard, C. A.; Holtzapple, M. T.; Duggleby, A. T.; Annamalai, K.
kamphuis-2020.title: Perspectives on the origin, derivation, meaning, and significance of the isotropic sky model
kamphuis-2020.note: History and derivation of the isotropic sky model and its (1 + cos β)/2 view factor. Finds that the result usually credited to Liu and Jordan was published correctly as early as Moon and Spencer (1942); recommends anisotropic models for accurate work. Cited by pvlib's isotropic model.

pveducation-air-mass.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-air-mass.title: Air mass (PVEducation)
pveducation-air-mass.note: Direct-beam intensity I_D = 1.353·0.7^(AM^0.678) kW/m² after Meinel and Meinel (1976), the altitude correction with a = 0.14 per km, and the rule that clear-day diffuse light is about 10 % of the direct beam.

pveducation-arbitrary-tilt.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-arbitrary-tilt.title: Arbitrary orientation and tilt (PVEducation)
pveducation-arbitrary-tilt.note: Direct light on a module of any tilt and azimuth: S_module = S_incident[cos α sin β cos(Ψ − Θ) + sin α cos β].

pveducation-tilted-surface.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-tilted-surface.title: Solar radiation on a tilted surface (PVEducation)
pveducation-tilted-surface.note: States the rule of thumb that a fixed tilt equal to the latitude maximises yearly output; steeper favours winter, flatter favours summer.

pveducation-insolation.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-insolation.title: Calculation of solar insolation (PVEducation)
pveducation-insolation.note: Clear-sky insolation from the Sun's position and air mass; notes that daily insolation in kWh/m² equals sun hours, and that these weather-free numbers are not used for system sizing.

pveducation-average-radiation.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-average-radiation.title: Average solar radiation (PVEducation)
pveducation-average-radiation.note: Defines peak sun hours: daily insolation expressed as hours at 1 kW/m², numerically equal to kWh/m² per day.

pveducation-declination.authors: Honsberg, C. B.; Bowden, S. G.
pveducation-declination.title: Declination angle (PVEducation)
pveducation-declination.note: The declination swings between about +23.45° and −23.45° over the year because of the tilt of Earth's axis; it is zero at the equinoxes.

pvwatts-v5-2014.title: PVWatts Version 5 Manual
pvwatts-v5-2014.note: Technical description of PVWatts: typical-year weather, a sky-diffuse model more detailed than the isotropic one, cell temperature, and system losses.

pvwatts-calculator.authors: National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL)
pvwatts-calculator.title: PVWatts Calculator
pvwatts-calculator.note: Free web tool that estimates a grid-connected PV system's monthly and yearly energy from typical-year weather data for an address.

nsrdb-2018.authors: Sengupta, M.; Xie, Y.; Lopez, A.; Habte, A.; Maclaurin, G.; Shelby, J.
nsrdb-2018.title: The National Solar Radiation Data Base (NSRDB)
nsrdb-2018.note: Satellite-derived hourly and half-hourly solar irradiance (GHI, DNI, DHI) with typical-year files, used by PVWatts and SAM.

nsrdb-viewer.authors: National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL)
nsrdb-viewer.title: National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB) viewer and downloads

jacobson-jadhav-2018.title: World estimates of PV optimal tilt angles and ratios of sunlight incident upon tilted and tracked PV panels relative to horizontal panels
jacobson-jadhav-2018.note: Optimal tilts from PVWatts weather data. Cloudier places have flatter optimal tilts because cloud-scattered light favours near-horizontal panels (e.g. 45° at Calgary, 51.1° N, but 34° at Beek, Netherlands, 50.9° N). Northern-hemisphere fit: tilt = 1.3793 + φ(1.2011 + φ(−0.014404 + 0.000080509 φ)).

pvlib-albedo.title: pvlib.albedo: SURFACE_ALBEDOS (pvlib python 0.16.1 documentation)
pvlib-albedo.note: Typical albedos used in PV modelling: grass 0.20, concrete 0.30, sand 0.40, fresh snow 0.75 (compiled from PVsyst's help pages and other sources).

geonames.title: GeoNames geographical database
geonames.note: Open gazetteer of place names with coordinates and elevations; the preset places on the sun path page use rounded city-centre values.
